units.source_text: 名人房间的廊道边上，绽开着一簇簇八仙花。

en.t: Along the corridor beside the master's room, clusters of hydrangeas were blooming.

units.source_text: 今天大黑凤蝶也飞落在这些花朵上，鲜艳的姿影倒映在泉水里。

en.t: Today, a large black swallowtail butterfly also settled on these blossoms, its vivid form reflected in the spring water.

units.source_text: 房檐下的藤架上，紫藤枝繁叶茂。

en.t: On the wisteria trellis beneath the eaves, the purple wisteria was thick with branches and leaves.
